# 725. Split Linked List in Parts

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
# Definition for singly-linked list.
# class ListNode(object):
#     def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
#         self.val = val
#         self.next = next
class Solution(object):
    def splitListToParts(self, head, k):
        """
        :type head: ListNode
        :type k: int
        :rtype: List[ListNode]
        """
        p = head
        cnt = 0
        while p:
            cnt += 1
            p = p.next
        cnt1, cnt2 = cnt / k, cnt % k
        p = head
        ans = []
        for i in range(k):
            if i < cnt2:
                cur_cnt = cnt1 + 1
            else:
                cur_cnt = cnt1
            if cur_cnt == 0:
                ans.append(None)
                continue
            ans.append(p)
            for _ in range(cur_cnt - 1):
                p = p.next
            t = p
            p = p.next
            t.next = None
        return ans
```
